summary: Iter10 verifies: (1) new POST /api/wallet/build_swap + /api/wallet/send_signed endpoints wired to Jupiter + Solana RPC with proper auth/validation; (2) TREASURY_* removed from backend/.env (0 refs in code, confirmed boot clean — 'engine started' in supervisor log); (3) all unfunded money paths return clean 400s at chain-execution stage (never 500); (4) chain-liveness endpoints (/api/wallet, /api/hl/account, /api/signals/hero) return live mainnet state; (5) branding-in-key-material audit — zero occurrences of weft/makers/makemarkets as prefix/suffix on key|secret|session|token|privkey|private identifiers in server.py (only legitimate sanitizer scrub patterns at lines 50,59); (6) frontend localStorage key is 'loom:session' (AuthContext.jsx:8). Backend pytest: 42 passed + 1 skipped (relay backtest upstream 429, expected) on test_relay+test_email_auth_wallets+test_gaps suites; new test_wallet_signed.py adds 16 passed. Frontend verified by signing in as trader1@weft.test (token-only localStorage) and navigating to /account — custodial 'Swap for real' button present, self-sign 'Build — sign in your wallet' panel correctly ABSENT for email users (wallet-trade-row element = null, which matches Account.jsx:168 gating), all 4 core testids (holdings-panel, paper-reset-btn, hl-equity-chart, hl-mkt-limit) render, live ETH price $2,391.85, Hyperliquid 0.00 / 0 open, Solana 0.0000. Only console error is pre-existing dev-overlay hydration warning (<span> child of <option>) also flagged in iter9. Self-sign branch verified by code inspection: Account.jsx:169 passes selfSign+signTransaction to SolTradePanel; SolTradePanel at 474-517 branches on selfSign — builds via /wallet/build_swap, calls wallet.signTransaction, broadcasts via /wallet/send_signed; panel label 'Swap on Solana · real · signed by your wallet' and button 'Build — sign in your wallet' (line 517).

AuthContext.jsx:8 uses 'loom:session' as localStorage key (confirmed via live login test — token-string persisted, /api/me/local 200 on reload). No weft/* storage keys remain in frontend.

Account.jsx self-sign branch (line 168-170 wallet-trade-row) is gated so email users never see the self-sign panel and non-email users (phantom/solflare connected) see only the self-sign panel — correct dual-path separation.
